topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 135 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 11 ERC20 tokens; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 6 common project-authored base contract(s) (rewarddistributormultiepoch, coreownable, epochtracker). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
